summary: Verified backend startup and core API routes after pinning aiofiles==25.1.0. Backend imports cleanly, supervisor shows backend RUNNING, and all 25 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. Covered: /api/health, /api/products (list + category filter + hidden exclusion), /api/contact (valid+minimal+422), /api/admin/login (success+401), /api/admin/stats (no/invalid/valid token), /api/admin/products CRUD, visibility toggle, bulk visibility, bulk delete.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend and mobile supervisor processes are in FATAL state (Exited too quickly) — out of scope for this backend-only bug-fix verification, but worth noting if a frontend test run is requested later.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (switched ADMIN_PASSWORD to env-based default 'admin123' to match /app/backend/.env; no application code changed)
seed_data_creation: Tests created transient TEST_ contact inquiries and TEST_ products; CRUD/bulk-delete tests clean up their own created records by id. Hide/unhide and bulk-visibility tests restore state in finally blocks. 50-product seed verified intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: aiofiles==25.1.0 pin resolves the production ModuleNotFoundError. Backend serves all documented /api routes on https://emergent-landing-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Use ADMIN_PASSWORD env (default admin123). backend_test.py is the full regression suite — all 25 green in ~6s.
rca of the issue: Loose constraint `aiofiles>=24.1.0` in requirements.txt allowed pip resolver to select an incompatible wheel or skip install in the production build environment, triggering ModuleNotFoundError at /app/backend/server.py line 8 on startup. Pinning to aiofiles==25.1.0 ensures a deterministic, verified install. Post-fix: supervisor backend RUNNING, /api/health 200 OK, 25/25 pytest cases pass.
